correctness.rationale: A three-layer strict radical matrix X has X² upper-right block AB. In characteristic two all involutions equal I+X with AB=0. Disjoint ranks alpha of A, beta of B, rho of C|kerB modulo imA yield rank X=alpha+beta+rho; counting A, B constrained to kerA, C free off kerB and lifted from quotient yields precisely the Gaussian rank product and q exponents. A complete tripartite matching realizes every rank through min(floor(N/2),N−max levels); the general bounds rule out higher ranks. The extracted standalone program agreed with brute-force matrix enumeration in 12 prime-field configurations; not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural involution-counting problem for an infinite three-parameter class of incidence-algebra unit groups in characteristic two is answered at the stronger granularity of every ambient Jordan type. The exact feasible interval and multiplicities resolve structural and arithmetic questions that neither total square-zero upper triangular counts nor unconstrained rank tables answer; the result is limited to the specified complete three-level posets.
